execution_authority: Human explicitly requested this turn's agents to inspect and clear useless storage waste. Root performs the single finite remote operation; this agent does not SSH or delete.
required_before_each_unlink: Root and all target ancestors resolve inside their intended exact cache directory, with no symlink traversal or filesystem crossing.
Target is an exact listed regular file, not a directory or symlink, with same device, inode, size, nlink=1, mtime_ns, mode, uid and gid as fresh metadata intent.

Complete conda .conda/.tar.bz2 archive is a direct child of a known conda package-cache directory; urls.txt is a regular sentinel and only URL path basename is matched in memory. Never print/save URL content.
mtime is at least 24 hours old at execution; future timestamps or files changed under 24 hours stay protected.
Fresh limited owner cache-use check if available; do not query unknown peer identities or scan process argv. If use cannot be excluded for a modified/recent file, leave it.
Immutable exact intent includes before stat and deletion rationale; per-target result records unlink success/error and post-absence without rerunning consumed cleanup.
Measure statvfs before/after by filesystem. Candidate sizes are estimates; only actual free-byte delta is actual release. Never add home-device release to durable-device release.
never_select: unknown datasets/applications or Recycle Bin originals
